references.text: The destruction of Jericho under Joshua's leadership, mentioned as a precedent for what happened to Ai
The capture and destruction of Ai, which Adoni-Zedek had heard about
The inhabitants of Gibeon who made peace with Israel, mentioned in this verse
The Gibeonites became part of the Israelite camp and lived among them
The first mention of Jerusalem with a king, Melchizedek, having a name element similar to Adoni-Zedek
Further description of Adoni-Zedek as king of Jerusalem
Later reference to Adoni-Bezek, another Canaanite king who was defeated
